constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'draft'::comunicacao_template_status) OR (canal <> 'whatsapp'::comunicacao_canal) OR ((provider_template_name IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(provider_template_name) >= 1) AND (length(provider_template_name) <= 512)) AND (language_code IS NOT NULL) AND (language_code ~ '^[a-z]{2}(_[A-Z]{2})?$'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(parameter_mapping) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(parameter_mapping) <= 64) AND (provider_template_status = 'approved'::text))))

constraints.name: ftr_crt_cst_csosn_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((tax_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['ICMS'::text, 'ICMS_ST'::text])) OR (crt IS NULL) OR ((crt = ANY (ARRAY['1'::text, '2'::text])) AND (csosn IS NOT NULL) AND (cst IS NULL)) OR ((crt = ANY (ARRAY['3'::text, '4'::text])) AND (cst IS NOT NULL) AND (csosn IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ftr_cst_csosn_exclusive
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cst IS NULL) OR (csosn IS NULL)))

constraints.name: ftr_pct_ranges
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((base_reduction_pct IS NULL) OR ((base_reduction_pct >= (0)::numeric) AND (base_reduction_pct <= (100)::numeric))) AND ((deferral_pct IS NULL) OR ((deferral_pct >= (0)::numeric) AND (deferral_pct <= (100)::numeric))) AND ((mva_pct IS NULL) OR (mva_pct >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((fcp_rate IS NULL) OR ((fcp_rate >= (0)::numeric) AND (fcp_rate <= (100)::numeric))) AND ((difal_dest_share_pct IS NULL) OR ((difal_dest_share_pct >= (0)::numeric) AND (difal_dest_share_pct <= (100)::numeric)))))

constraints.name: ftr_published_requires_evidence
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR ((source_id IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(legal_basis, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (published_by IS NOT NULL) AND ((cst IS NOT NULL) OR (csosn IS NOT NULL) OR (tax_kind = ANY (ARRAY['IBS'::text, 'CBS'::text, 'IS'::text]))) AND ((calc_mode <> 'PERCENT'::text) OR (rate IS NOT NULL)) AND ((calc_mode = 'PERCENT'::text) OR (length(btrim(COALESCE(justification, ''::text))) >= 20)))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((origin_uf IS NULL) OR (fn_fiscal_uf_ibge_code(origin_uf) IS NOT NULL)) AND ((destination_uf IS NULL) OR (destination_uf = 'EX'::text) OR (fn_fiscal_uf_ibge_code(destination_uf) IS NOT NULL))))

views.definition:
SELECT os_id,
    origem_os,
    numero_os,
    cliente_id,
    fazenda_id,
    talhao_id,
    status_os,
    created_at,
    volume_total_ml,
    produto_id,
    microrganismo_id,
    prioridade,
    volume_solicitado_l,
    cliente_nome,
    fazenda_nome,
    talhao_nome,
    produto_nome,
    microrganismo_nome,
    partner_id,
    partner_numero,
    partner_nome,
    titular_tipo,
    titular_nome,
    programacao_id,
    status_programacao,
    data_programada,
    data_inicio_producao,
    lote_id,
    codigo_lote,
    status_lote,
    data_lote,
    cq_id,
    cq_resultado,
    data_cq,
    envase_id,
    data_envase,
    estoque_id,
    data_estoque,
    estoque_reservado_id,
    data_estoque_reservado,
    entrega_id,
    entrega_status,
    data_entrega,
    aplicacao_id,
    data_aplicacao,
    entrega_confirmada,
    aplicacao_bloqueante,
    pendencias_informativas,
    bloqueios,
    pode_finalizar,
        CASE
            WHEN (status_esteira_oficial = ANY (ARRAY['programada'::text, 'aberta'::text])) AND (status_os = 'em_producao'::text OR status_programacao = 'em_producao'::text) THEN 'em_producao'::text
            ELSE status_esteira_oficial
        END AS status_esteira_oficial,
    tempo_os_ate_programacao,
    tempo_programacao_ate_lote,
    tempo_lote_ate_cq,
    tempo_cq_ate_envase,
    tempo_envase_ate_entrega,
    tempo_os_ate_entrega,
    atrasado,
        CASE
            WHEN programacao_id IS NULL THEN 'Programar Produção'::text
            WHEN lote_id IS NULL THEN 'Gerar Lote'::text
            WHEN cq_id IS NULL OR cq_resultado IS NULL THEN 'Realizar CQ'::text
            WHEN cq_resultado = 'reprovado'::text THEN 'Tratar reprovação'::text
            WHEN envase_id IS NULL THEN 'Registrar Envase'::text
            WHEN estoque_reservado_id IS NULL THEN 'Gerar Estoque/Reserva'::text
            WHEN entrega_id IS NULL THEN 'Confirmar Entrega'::text
            WHEN NOT entrega_confirmada THEN 'Confirmar Entrega'::text
            WHEN pode_finalizar AND status_os <> 'finalizada'::text THEN 'Finalizar OS'::text
            WHEN status_os = 'finalizada'::text THEN 'Concluído'::text
            ELSE 'Verificar Status'::text
        END AS proxima_acao
   FROM vw_os_integridade_esteira;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_rule_log_allowed(p_action text, p_partner uuid, p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(p_action IN ('price_rule_insert','price_rule_update','price_rule_delete')
 AND (p_before IS NOT NULL OR p_after IS NOT NULL)
 AND platform_private.c2p1_rule_snapshot_allowed(p_before,p_partner)
 AND platform_private.c2p1_rule_snapshot_allowed(p_after,p_partner),false);
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_registro_consultor(_registro_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT _registro_id IS NOT NULL
     AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
     AND (
       public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::app_role)
       OR public.can_view_technical_visit(auth.uid(), _registro_id)
       OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.registros_consultor r
            WHERE r.id = _registro_id
              AND (
                r.consultor_responsavel = auth.uid()
                OR r.created_by = auth.uid()
                OR r.finalized_by = auth.uid()
                OR r.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
              )
          )
     );
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_uf_ibge_code(_uf text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE upper(btrim(coalesce(_uf,'')))
    WHEN 'RO' THEN '11' WHEN 'AC' THEN '12' WHEN 'AM' THEN '13' WHEN 'RR' THEN '14'
    WHEN 'PA' THEN '15' WHEN 'AP' THEN '16' WHEN 'TO' THEN '17' WHEN 'MA' THEN '21'
    WHEN 'PI' THEN '22' WHEN 'CE' THEN '23' WHEN 'RN' THEN '24' WHEN 'PB' THEN '25'
    WHEN 'PE' THEN '26' WHEN 'AL' THEN '27' WHEN 'SE' THEN '28' WHEN 'BA' THEN '29'
    WHEN 'MG' THEN '31' WHEN 'ES' THEN '32' WHEN 'RJ' THEN '33' WHEN 'SP' THEN '35'
    WHEN 'PR' THEN '41' WHEN 'SC' THEN '42' WHEN 'RS' THEN '43' WHEN 'MS' THEN '50'
    WHEN 'MT' THEN '51' WHEN 'GO' THEN '52' WHEN 'DF' THEN '53'
    ELSE NULL END;
$function$

functions.name: h15_fiscal_audit_access
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_fiscal_audit_access(p_table text, p_record uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF public.h15_actor_organization() IS NULL OR p_record IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  RETURN CASE p_table
    WHEN 'company_fiscal_settings' THEN public.h15_company_access(p_record)
    WHEN 'fiscal_invoices' THEN public.h15_invoice_access(p_record)
    WHEN 'fiscal_events' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_events e WHERE e.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(e.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_xml_runs' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs r WHERE r.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(r.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_sefaz_transmissions' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_sefaz_transmissions t WHERE t.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(t.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_protocoled_documents' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_protocoled_documents d WHERE d.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(d.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_certificates' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_certificates c WHERE c.id=p_record AND public.h15_company_access(c.company_settings_id))
    ELSE false
  END;
END;
$function$

functions.name: tenant_email_actor_org
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_email_actor_org()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid())
 OR platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(auth.uid()) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 SELECT p.organization_id INTO v_org FROM public.profiles p
 JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.senha_provisoria IS FALSE AND o.ativo IS TRUE;
 RETURN v_org;
END $function$
